The first pre-release of tenken: a CLI that checks a web site in one run and fails your CI when the site has a problem.

## What it does

- Five checks in one run: TLS certificate (`cert`), redirects (`redirects`), broken links including mixed content (`links`), security headers (`headers`), and sitemap / `robots.txt` (`sitemap`)
- Exit code `1` when there are `fail` findings (or warnings, with `--fail-on warn`), `3` when it could not check, `2` for a usage error, `0` otherwise ([`docs/cli-reference.md`](https://github.com/hidetzu/tenken/blob/v0.1.0-dev.1/docs/cli-reference.md) §4)
- Text or JSON output (`--format json`, `schema_version` 1)
- Says what it did not check: URLs not fetched, limits hit, checks skipped
- Polite and bounded: obeys the start site's `robots.txt` and `Crawl-delay`, one request at a time per host, `--max-duration` and `--max-requests` for the whole run
- Connects to private addresses only on the start URL's host, and only when that host is local ([`README.md`](https://github.com/hidetzu/tenken/blob/v0.1.0-dev.1/README.md#security))

## Install

```sh
go install github.com/hidetzu/tenken/cmd/tenken@v0.1.0-dev.1
```

It needs Go 1.27 or newer. Or download an archive below for Linux (amd64, arm64), macOS (amd64, arm64) or Windows (amd64), and check it against `tenken_0.1.0-dev.1_checksums.txt`.

## Known limitations

- It reads the HTML the server sends: it does not run JavaScript and sends no credentials, so links built by scripts and pages behind a login are not checked
- `cert` checks the certificate of the last https host of the start URL's redirects only, not the hosts part way along
- `--quiet` is accepted and does nothing yet: there is no progress output and no colour
- Through a proxy (`HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY`), the destination is not checked against private addresses, and `cert` through a proxy has not been confirmed end to end
- The sitemap's URLs are checked one at a time, in order (`--concurrency` does not apply to them)
- Internationalised domain names are fetched, but shown percent-encoded, and a Unicode and a punycode reference to the same host count as different URLs

The full list is [`docs/discovery.md`](https://github.com/hidetzu/tenken/blob/v0.1.0-dev.1/docs/discovery.md) §2.

This is a pre-release: flags, rule IDs and the output may still change before v0.1.0.
